extraItems.title: Senior Benefits & Eldercare
extraItems.summary: Free benefit screenings, the Eldercare Locator, Medicaid waivers and PACE that pay for in-home care, VA Aid & Attendance, home-delivered meals and getting paid as a family caregiver.

extraItems.title: Free & Low-Cost Help for Seniors
extraItems.summary: Discounts and free programs for seniors on phone and internet, energy bills, food coupons, prescriptions, transport, fitness, tax help and park passes.

extraItems.title: Disability Benefits & Income
extraItems.summary: SSDI and SSI monthly income, the health coverage that comes with them, how to apply and appeal a denial for free, ABLE savings accounts and Ticket to Work.

extraItems.title: Disability Support & Services
extraItems.summary: Centers for Independent Living, in-home care through Medicaid, vocational rehabilitation, assistive technology, job accommodations and free legal protection of your rights.

extraItems.title: Disability Housing & Home Modifications
extraItems.summary: Free ramps, grab bars and repairs, USDA and Medicaid programs, VA housing grants, HUD counselors and Section 811 supportive housing, plus 211 and findhelp.org for local funds.
